title: eta.shipment.predicted
description: One event per ETA prediction for a dispatched shipment. Published by the eta-prediction service to the Kafka topic named after event_type (eta.shipment.predicted), partition key = payload.shipment_id, so all predictions for one shipment stay in order. Delivery is at-least-once. A shipment can be re-predicted, which publishes a new event with a new event_id: consumers de-duplicate on event_id and keep the prediction with the latest payload.predicted_at per shipment_id.

event_id.description: UUID v4, unique per published event.

occurred_at.description: UTC time the event was published.

shipment_id.description: Canonical shipment id, taken from supplierportal.shipment.dispatched.

po_number.description: Canonical PO number, taken from supplierportal.shipment.dispatched.

eta_days.description: Predicted calendar days from dispatched_at to delivery.

confidence_low.description: Lower bound of the 80% prediction interval, in days from dispatched_at. Must be <= confidence_high. eta_days is NOT required to lie inside [confidence_low, confidence_high]: the interval is calibrated asymmetrically from out-of-sample residuals.

confidence_high.description: Upper bound of the 80% prediction interval, in days from dispatched_at.

model_version.description: MLflow registered model name and version that produced the prediction, e.g. eta_pipeline/3.

predicted_at.description: UTC time the prediction was made. Latest predicted_at per shipment_id wins.

top_features.description: Optional SHAP explanation of this prediction, ordered by absolute shap_value, largest first.

shap_value.description: Signed contribution in days; positive pushes the ETA later.
